docs.title: Hello, I'm Nikhil Kumar.
docs.text:
I am a Data Engineer pivoting to AI Systems, based in San Diego.

With a background in building large-scale data pipelines (Spark, Kafka) at enterprise scale, I now focus on building autonomous AI agents and LLM infrastructure.

docs.title: Core Stack
docs.text:
• AI/ML: LangChain, Ollama, Agents, PyTorch
  • Data Engineering: Apache Spark, Kafka, BigQuery
  • Languages: Python, SQL

docs.title: Local llm
docs.text: The Angle: "Running LLMs in the cloud is expensive and poses privacy risks. I built a local RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) system using Ollama and Llama 3 to process sensitive documents locally."

docs.title: Autonomous YouTube Shorts Generator
docs.text:
The Problem: "Content creation is time-consuming. I wanted to automate the research, scriptwriting, and asset gathering for short-form video."

The Tech: "Built using LangChain for orchestration. I used a multi-agent architecture where one agent researches (Search Tools), one writes scripts (LLM), and one gathers media."
